errors.error_description: Declared an internal net that is never connected or used, creating an unconnected internal net.
Used bitwise AND '&' in a conditional instead of logical AND '&&', which can produce unintended behavior.
Created a state-holding process without a proper clock edge using 'always @(req_valid)', inferring sequential behavior from a data signal.
Drove an input port with a continuous assignment inside the module, violating port directionality and data type rules.
